description: Updates the status of an issue group (issues aggregation). Use this to mark issues as resolved, closed, in progress, etc.

app_id.description: The public app ID (e.g. 5X3c4veRGV) from list_apps

issue_id.description: The issue group hash from list_issues or get_issue

status.description: New status: new, open, in_progress, resolved, closed, muted, or invalid

name: update_issue_status
